items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree or any combination of education and experience that provides the required skills and abilities.
Minimum of five years of experience in fundraising, alumni relations, admissions, or a related area in higher education or a comparable organization.
Manage a portfolio composed primarily of CGU alumni, moving relationships toward deeper engagement and giving through purposeful visits and timely follow-up.
Meet monthly targets for donor engagement, portfolio movement, solicitations, and fundraising results, contributing to the team’s overall goal.
Generate support for the Transformation Fund, helping alumni understand why bridge funding matters during the University’s transformation.
Conduct stewardship conversations, discuss giving opportunities, and make direct gift requests.
Maintain accurate contact reports, strategies, ask amounts, and next steps in Slate so that each prospect has a current stage and a dated next action.
Build authentic one-to-one relationships with alumni across generations, professions, and career stages.
Host donors and prospective donors on campus, and create opportunities for them to engage with CGU’s leadership, faculty, and students.
Represent CGU at meetings and events with professionalism and discretion.
Take part in team portfolio management meetings with advancement leadership and fundraising colleagues to evaluate donor movement, set strategies, determine ask amounts, and define next steps.

Lead donor meetings independently and coordinate joint meetings with the Office of the President, faculty, and advancement leadership from start to finish, including scheduling, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
Prepare meeting participants with donor background, meeting objectives, proposed roles, discussion points, and expected next steps.
